result.question: Qual a taxa de mortalidade no estado do Rio Grande do Sul em 2021?
result.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021;
